detail.longDescription: Wow, that was unexpected. I've played terraria before and had beaten moon lord on legendary diff and that butterfly thingy at daytime and got the rainbow sword.. thingy. I've seen Calamity mod and had seen my brother and his friends play a bit bout it. Now that I thought about it, it kinda was expected cos it came from Discord. It really is where weirdos, nerds, groomers, geeks, predators, preys and other socially inept people nest and congregate. Good thing I don't use it anymore. That place has always given me the heebie-jeebies. Besides, I don't have internet friends and don't plan to make one, lol. I mean, it's been 7 years and I've been fine. Sometimes I wish I knew what it feels like to have friends long term but I'm self-sufficient and I haven't really needed other people's validations throughout the years cos I know what I wanna do for myself. https:// youtu.be/d90jflrkEnw # terraria # gaming # indie # sandbox # pcgaming # modding # discord # programming # linux
